source_notes: The extended real-package suites precede test-only Wayland readiness diagnostics and Windows firewall cleanup. Core operation and trust sources are identical. Desktop harness 19068b0 counts the added uninstall/reinstall cases against unchanged a22563d applications.

headless.isolation: unmodified OS images; no network/display/graphics/FUSE; read-only OS; empty client PATH
headless.scope: headless CLI; GUI acceptance runs in installed Ubuntu Desktop VMs

limitations: Windows and macOS run on hosted CI machines with external runtimes removed from client PATH, not freshly installed desktop VMs.
Clean Ubuntu Desktop tests use QEMU/KVM virtual graphics; physical GPU coverage remains open.
Real dashboard tests verify installed payloads, permissions, symlinks and inventory; they do not launch the dashboard apps.
Uninstall removes packages but retains user files, manager and verified caches for reinstall.
Disposable test trust keys and unsigned/unnotarized distribution artifacts are not production releases.

run_notes.native_client: All four native jobs passed. Superseded dependent Desktop jobs were cancelled; fixture_desktop tests the same application with the corrected controller.
run_notes.real_desktop_application_build: Package/application build passed. Superseded Desktop jobs were cancelled; real_desktop tests the same executable and bundles with the corrected controller.
run_notes.real_offline: Linux and both Mac jobs passed. Windows package tests passed, but artifact upload failed after firewall isolation. real_offline_windows_rerun includes DNS cleanup and passed including artifact upload.
